title: AI-Assisted Promotional Images for Panama City Snow Attraction Allegedly Misled Ticket Buyers Before Deceptive-Advertising Fine
summary: Organizers of Snowland Panamá, a ticketed winter-themed attraction in Panama City, used purportedly AI-assisted promotional images that allegedly portrayed an experience substantially different from what the venue delivered. Ticket buyers complained that the advertising misrepresented the attraction, and the event was canceled. Panama's consumer-protection authority subsequently fined the responsible business for deceptive advertising and facilitated refunds.
